quantize_vlm_with_autoround: quantize a vision language model using AutoRound with 4-bit symmetric quantization and save in auto_round format
run_qwen_vl_inference: run inference on a quantized Qwen2-VL model with an image and text prompt using AutoProcessor
get_vision_block_names: get the block names for a multimodal LLM model with optional vision module quantization using get_block_names
detect_mllm_model: detect whether a given model is a multimodal LLM using is_mllm_model and load it with mllm_load_model
test_early_stop_calibration: test early-stop behavior during calibration caching for Llama-3.2 vision model using AutoRound cache_inter_data
